articles.title: Jeanne des Anges: The Loudun Nun's Own Story
articles.h1: Jeanne des Anges: the Loudun nun, in her own words
articles.description: Urbain Grandier burned in 1634, but the prioress at the heart of the Loudun possessions wrote her own account. It is not what you would expect.

hero.alt: Seventeenth-century etching of Urbain Grandier tied to a stake and burning in a crowded square at Loudun, soldiers and onlookers around him
hero.caption: Urbain Grandier burned alive at Loudun, 1634. Etching attributed to Caspar Luyken, 1701. Rijksmuseum, Amsterdam (CC0).

FIG2.alt: Nineteenth-century engraving of Father Surin kneeling in a vaulted room as a horned, winged demon looms over him
FIG2.caption: Father Surin and the demon Isacaaron. Victor Armand Poirson, 1886, for Figuier, Les Mystères de la science. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

FIG3.alt: Painting of Dr Charcot demonstrating hysteria on a swooning woman patient to a packed hall of physicians at the Salpêtrière
FIG3.caption: André Brouillet, A Clinical Lesson at the Salpêtrière, 1887. Charcot's school is the one that first printed Jeanne's text as a medical case. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

FIG4.alt: Facsimile of a handwritten page in seventeenth-century French script, the so-called letter of the demon Asmodeus, written in Jeanne's own hand
FIG4.caption: The "letter of the demon Asmodeus", written in Jeanne's own hand. Facsimile in the 1886 edition (University of Toronto copy, Internet Archive). Public domain.

articles.credits: Pictures: Rijksmuseum (CC0); Wikimedia Commons (public domain); Internet Archive, University of Toronto copy of the 1886 edition (public domain). Quotations are from our translation of the 1886 French printing.

book.name: Possessed: The Memoir of the Nun of Loudun
book.author: Jeanne des Anges
book.blurb: Jeanne des Anges's complete autobiography of the Loudun possessions, in English: her whole account, every extract from her later letters, an introduction, timeline, notes, glossary and period pictures.
book.cover_alt: Cover of Possessed: the Memoir of the Nun of Loudun, showing Jeanne des Anges's handwriting

articles.title: Palmistry History: The Physician Who Tried to Prove It
articles.h1: The physician who tried to prove palmistry
articles.description: In 1653 a French court physician asked whether palmistry had any basis in medicine. His answer, printed in English in 1658, ends in a remarkable admission.

hero.alt: A hand drawn with the signs of the planets and the zodiac around it, from an English manuscript manual of palmistry dated 1648
hero.caption: The hand as the palmists mapped it: an English manuscript manual of chiromancy dated 1648, ten years before this book. Wellcome Collection, CC BY 4.0.

FIG2.alt: A palm with each finger named in Latin and marked with its planet, the lines of the palm labelled, hand-coloured woodcut of 1501
FIG2.caption: The planets on the fingers as the palmists placed them: Jupiter on the forefinger, Saturn on the middle finger, the Sun on the third, Mercury on the little finger. Hand-coloured woodcut from Magnus Hundt, Antropologium (Leipzig, 1501). Wellcome Collection, CC BY 4.0.

FIG3.alt: Three hands with the principal lines named, including the line of life, the liver line and the table line, with the planets on the fingers
FIG3.caption: The lines and the planets of the hand, from the same English manual of chiromancy dated 1648. Wellcome Collection, CC BY 4.0.

articles.credits: Pictures: Wellcome Collection, licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). The 1658 book itself has no illustrations. Quotations are from the 1658 English translation, spelling modernised.

book.name: The Principles of Chiromancy
book.author: Marin Cureau de La Chambre
book.blurb: The whole 1658 English translation, modernised and annotated: a foreword, notes on every Article, a glossary of palmistry terms and seventeenth-century words, and a list of every correction to the 1658 printing.
book.cover_alt: Cover of The Principles of Chiromancy, with a hand drawing from a seventeenth-century manual
